correctness.how: run_deterministic.py drives the shipped collection, source-record, and inbox-selector scripts over a synthetic Project, and proves grade_trajectory.py against synthetic Codex logs. grade_trajectory.py then grades real scheduled runs from Codex session logs for forbidden behavior.

cost.how: grade_trajectory.py reports total, input, cached-input, and output tokens per graded scheduled run from the Codex log's token counts.
cost.note: Tokens only: no dollar pricing is applied, and no baseline arm exists to compare against.

time.note: Harness duration is runner performance, not a saving. No human baseline has been recorded.

with-skills.note: The deterministic runner exercises the shipped scripts; the trajectory grader reads real runs of the shipped skill.

baseline-no-skills.note: No unaided model has been asked to check sources and fill the inbox on a schedule.

consistency.note: Token spread needs more graded scheduled runs of the same fixture-like workload; real runs differ in how much new material they find.

coverage.rationale: Protect the collection guarantees and the scheduled-run behavior boundary established during the Codex spike and end-to-end test.

trials.rationale: Each run uses a fresh synthetic workspace; the scripts are deterministic.

graders.rationale: File and state checks directly grade source selection, cursor handling, de-duplication, safe writes, passcode stripping, and failure handling.
Tool calls in the Codex session log directly show whether a scheduled run stayed inside its contract. The grader is proven on synthetic clean and violating logs before it is trusted on real ones.

skills_invoked.note: grade_trajectory.py grades only scheduled turns whose prompt invokes $workspace-collect.

never_runs_workspace_add.note: Graded on scheduled turns only; a later turn where the user replies ingest is expected to run workspace-add.

never_uses_browser_or_search.note: Browser, desktop, and screen tools, Slack and Teams search, and connector tools absent from the contracts fail the run.

clarifying_questions.note: Setup conversations are not graded yet.

gaps.question: cost
gaps.statement: The collection task has not been run with Ascent skills withheld.
gaps.unblocked_by: Schedule the same prompt on the same host and model without the plugin and grade its log.

gaps.question: cost
gaps.statement: Token counts are reported without a price.
gaps.unblocked_by: Apply the host model's published per-token prices, separating cached input.

gaps.question: time
gaps.statement: No one has recorded how long checking Slack and Teams and filling the inbox takes by hand.
gaps.unblocked_by: Time a person doing one week's check, or record a dated delivery-lead estimate.

gaps.question: correctness
gaps.statement: The trajectory grader reads real runs; nothing launches model runs against fake connectors on demand.
gaps.unblocked_by: Add a headless host run against stub Slack and Teams servers and grade its log.

gaps.question: correctness
gaps.statement: Source selection and schedule questions in the setup conversation are not graded.
gaps.unblocked_by: Extend the trajectory grader to composer turns that create the schedule.

aggregation.note: The runner prints its summary but does not yet write run records under results/runs.

taxonomy.note: Several failure modes come from the 2026-10-19 Codex spike: Slack search, browser fallback on a failed connector, and an interactive stall.
